annotation.title_clean: Voorstel van resolutie om de inzet van "killer robots" en gewapende drones door de Belgische Defensie te verbieden / Proposition de résolution visant à interdire l'utilisation, par la Défense belge, de robots tueurs et de drones armés
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a resolution to ban the use of "killer robots" and armed drones by the Belgian Defence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Belgische Kamer van Volksvertegenwoordigers (Buysrogge, Miller, Yüksel, Vandenput, Grosemans, Bellens)
annotation.venue: Chamber of Representatives of Belgium, DOC 54 3203/001
annotation.summary_en: Belgian Chamber of Representatives draft resolution (June 2018) asking the federal government to ensure Belgian Defence never deploys "killer robots", to push for a global ban on fully automated lethal robots and armed drones, to join CCW/UN definitional work, and to keep supporting civilian robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Government to participate in UN/CCW working groups to define 'killer robots'
Campaign internationally with like-minded states for a global ban on fully automated killer robots and armed drones
Ensure Belgian Defence never deploys killer robots in military operations
Support development and use of robotics for civilian purposes
Rationale: humans must remain closely involved and accountable for lethal force; Belgium pioneered landmine and cluster munition bans
